stem:
Hitesh needs equal time intervals for a class pulse count and has no clock.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: A simple pendulum that swings back and forth with a steady period can mark equal intervals.
A dripping tap that drips at a steady rate can mark equal intervals.
A single clap that happens only once can mark many equal intervals by itself.
Any one-time event is enough, because time does not need repetition.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal time intervals need a repeating process with a steady period, such as a pendulum swing or a steady drip—not a one-time event.
